name: MonarchDragHandle
title: DragHandle
wrapsNative: Shape (grip dots), accessibilityActions(_:), accessibilityValue(_:); the caller attaches gesture(_:) or draggable(_:)
summary: The grip an item is dragged by: a dotted glyph in a 44-point touch target with a spoken name, idle, grabbed and dropped states, and move actions for VoiceOver and Switch Control.
whenToUse: When you build a drag interaction outside a List (a board column, a canvas, a custom stack) and need the handle part with an accessible way to move the item.
whenNotToUse: In a List, use the system reordering with onMove(perform:), which brings its own handle and accessibility.
api: MonarchDragHandle.init(_ label: String, state: MonarchDragHandleState = .idle, axis: MonarchDragHandleAxis = .vertical, size: MonarchDragHandleSize = .md, hint: String? = nil, actionLabels: [MonarchDragHandleDirection: String] = [:], stateLabels: [MonarchDragHandleState: String] = [:], onMove: (@MainActor (MonarchDragHandleDirection) -> Void)? = nil)
enum MonarchDragHandleState { case idle, grabbed, dropped }
enum MonarchDragHandleAxis { case vertical, horizontal, both }
enum MonarchDragHandleDirection { case up, down, backward, forward }

options.name: label
options.description: The spoken name, naming the item: "Reorder Design review".

options.name: state
options.description: idle, grabbed or dropped. The view that moves items owns it.

options.name: axis
options.description: vertical, horizontal or both. Selects the grip pattern and the move actions.

options.name: size
options.description: sm: 24 points. md: 32 points. The touch target is 44 points at both.

options.name: actionLabels
options.description: Replaces the built-in action names "Move up", "Move down", "Move backward", "Move forward".

options.name: stateLabels
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken values "Picked up" and "Dropped".

options.name: onMove
options.description: Moves the item one step. Without it the handle offers no actions.

states.name: grabbed
states.description: Accent subtle fill, accent strong dots and a 1-point accent outline. Spoken value "Picked up".

states.name: dropped
states.description: Success subtle fill and success strong dots, as a brief confirmation. Spoken value "Dropped".

states.name: disabled
states.description: Dots in the disabled text role and no actions, with the standard disabled(_:) modifier.

appearance: The dots use the muted text role at rest, the accent roles while grabbed and the success roles when dropped, in every theme. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: On the web the handle is a button with keyboard instructions and aria-pressed. On iOS it is not a button: activating it does nothing, the drag is a gesture the caller attaches, and assistive technology uses the named move actions instead of arrow keys. The web's hover style and custom icon slot are not offered. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The handle is one element named by label; the grip is decorative.
With onMove, VoiceOver and Switch Control get one named action per direction of the axis: "Move up" and "Move down", "Move backward" and "Move forward", or all four.
The grabbed and dropped states are spoken as the element's value; an idle handle has no value.
The grabbed handle has an outline as well as a colour change.
The touch target is at least 44 by 44 points at both sizes, and the glyph scales with Dynamic Type.
The state change is not animated when Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: The handle does not move anything itself and does not announce the new position; post an announcement from onMove.
It installs no gesture. A drag works only when the caller attaches one.
backward and forward are positions in reading order, so they need no change for right-to-left layouts.
An empty override in actionLabels or stateLabels is ignored.

examples.title: States, axes and sizes
examples.code:
HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.space4) {
    MonarchDragHandle(
        "Reorder Idle item",
        state: .idle,
        axis: .vertical,
        size: .md
    )
    MonarchDragHandle(
        "Reorder Picked-up item",
        state: .grabbed,
        axis: .vertical,
        size: .md
    )
    MonarchDragHandle(
        "Reorder Dropped item",
        state: .dropped,
        axis: .vertical,
        size: .md
    )
    MonarchDragHandle(
        "Reorder Locked item",
        state: .idle,
        axis: .vertical,
        size: .md
    )
    .disabled(true)
    MonarchDragHandle(
        "Reorder Tile",
        state: .idle,
        axis: .both,
        size: .sm
    )
}
